quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation IR presentation: Presentation Materials (FY2026 2Q) (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 2Q results deck (July-September 2026 quarter, consolidated): net sales JPY 142.8 billion (+36.4% YoY, +24.9% QoQ), gross profit margin 71.7%, operating income JPY 67.6 billion (+52.3% YoY), operating income margin 47.4%; consolidated shipment value JPY 148.6 billion, a record high (page 7). First-half shipment value 'reached a record high (up approx. 40% YoY)', with shipments of dicers and grinders driven mainly by generative-AI demand and plants remaining busy. Quarterly forecast for 3Q (October-December 2026, page 14): net sales JPY 132.4 billion, operating income JPY 58.1 billion, net income JPY 41.5 billion, shipments JPY 149.6 billion, assuming 1 US dollar = 151 yen and 1 euro = 173 yen; currency sensitivity (annualized): US dollar approx. 2.1 billion yen, euro approx. 0.1 billion yen.
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q net sales JPY 142.8 billion (+36.4% YoY); 2Q shipments JPY 148.6 billion (record); 3Q forecast shipments JPY 149.6 billion, net sales JPY 132.4 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation IR presentation: Presentation Materials (FY2026 2Q) (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 2Q composition (page 21, shipment basis): precision processing equipment 63% of shipments (+8% QoQ, +66% YoY) - dicers 33% (+77% YoY; blade dicers +67%, laser saws +91%), grinders 26% (+47%), accessory equipment 4% (+149%); precision processing tools (consumables) 23% (+24% QoQ, +45% YoY), described as a record high 'driven by factors including customers' equipment utilization rates'; total shipments +54% YoY. Region mix (acceptance basis): Asia 78% - China 31% (including local factories of foreign manufacturers), Taiwan 26%, Korea 11%, Singapore 8% - Japan 10%, Europe 7%, North America 5%; overseas sales ratio 89.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: laser saws +91% YoY; grinders +47%; consumables +45% YoY (record); China 31%, Taiwan 26%, Korea 11% of sales

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation IR presentation: Presentation Materials (FY2026 2Q) (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 2Q application mix (pages 8-10 and 21, shipment basis): dicers - IC 73%, optical semiconductors 10%, non-semiconductors 10%, other semiconductors 5%, package singulation 3%; grinders - IC 77%, other semiconductors 8%, wafer manufacturing 7%, optical semiconductors 5%, non-semiconductors 3%. Disco states that QoQ, 'In addition to IC-related applications, particularly those for generative AI, sales for optical semiconductors and optical components (non-semiconductors) related to CPO (Co-Packaged Optics) increased', and that IC-related grinder sales for generative AI 'continued to drive overall grinder sales'. Outlook slide: 'Demand for KKM expands as semiconductor packaging technologies evolve'.
quarterly_data.figure: dicers: IC 73%, optical semiconductors 10%; grinders: IC 77%

quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation IR presentation: Presentation Materials (FY2026 2Q) (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 2Q results deck, forecasts and investment (pages 16-18): 3Q product forecast on a shipment basis, QoQ - grinders 10%, accessory equipment 10%, precision processing equipment 5%, blade dicers -5%, laser saws 0%, dicers 'Slight decrease', precision processing tools (consumables) -5%, others -10%. FY26 forecast: CAPEX approx. 33.0 billion yen 'including rationalization investment, reconstruction of the Haneda R&D Center, and construction of a new plant', depreciation approx. 16.0 billion yen, R&D expenses approx. 38.0 billion yen. Breakdown: Haneda R&D Center new building approx. 14 billion yen and Hiroshima Works new plant approx. 33 billion yen, payment timing FY25~27. Disco says it is 'Steadily strengthening production capacity under our Fab-Important strategy'.
